description_en: Guthi Chẽ 4 stands as a three-storied structure within the courtyard adjacent to the two front buildings opposite the Matsyendranātha Mandira (LAL0060) in Taḥ Bāhāḥ. These two front buildings currently house the Patan Office of the Guṭhī Saṃsthāna. Situated on the northern side of the courtyard, this building is the fourth in a series, all designated by the name Guthi Chẽ (building) followed by a sequential number for ease of documentation. Similar to Guthi Chẽ 3 (LAL0064), Guthi Chẽ 4 serves as a storage facility for items associated with the procession of the Buṅgadyaḥ Chariot (LAL0001).Facing towards the south, the building features a ground floor design reminiscent of aphalcā. In its original configuration, the bays on this level were open, but they have since been enclosed to create a functional room. Historical records suggest that this building likely dates back to the Rāṇā period, having either been constructed or reconstructed during that era. However, even prior to the earthquakes of 2015, the building was already showing signs of wear. The seismic events further exacerbated its condition, rendering it unusable since.The space encompassing the courtyard in front of Guthi Chẽ 4 serves multiple purposes. It serves as a workspace for painting ritual pots and preparing worship materials for various ceremonies. Additionally, this area accommodates the crafting of the finial seat (bāymvaḥ) for the chariot, the simmering of canes, and the preparation of wooden components required for the chariot's construction.
description_ne: त: बाहा:स्थित मत्स्येन्द्रनाथ मन्दिर (LAL0060) को ठिक सामुन्ने भएका गुठी संस्थानको कार्यालय रहेका दुई घरहरू छन् । यी घरका पछाडि मत्स्येन्द्रनाथको रथजात्राका विविध वस्तुहरू तयार गरिने ठुलो चोक छ । उक्त चोकको उत्तरतिर यो घर अवस्थित छ । विशेषतः मत्स्येन्द्रनाथको रथजात्राका सामग्री भण्डारण गर्न यो घर प्रयोग हुँदै आएको छ ।तीन तले दक्षिणाभिमुख घरको भूमितल्लामा कवलहरू निकाली फल्चाको रूप दिइएको छ । हाल ती कवलहरू बन्द गरी कोठाको रूपमा प्रयोगमा ल्याइएका छन् । भवनको झ्याल, झ्याल किनाराका इँटको बुट्टा आदिका आधारमा यसको निर्माण वा पुनर्निर्माण राणाकालमा गरिएको थाहा हुन्छ । विसं २०७२ सालअघि नै जीर्ण अवस्थामा रहेको यस भवनलाई भूकम्पले थप नाजुक तुल्याएकोले अहिले (जुलाई सन् २०२२) प्रयोगविहीन अवस्थामा रहेको छ । घरअगाडिको चोकमा रथजात्राका दौरान चाँदीका भाडाहरू रङ्गाउने कार्य लगायत अन्य पूजाजन्य वस्तु तयार पार्ने, बेतलाई तताउने, बाय्‌म्व: बनाउने र रथमा प्रयोग हुने अनेक प्रकारका काष्ठ सामग्री तयार गर्ने गरिन्छ ।
monument_assessment: Surface damages, Slightly damaged (minor damages such as minor cracks, plants, missing stones in plinths)
